description: Scripts, data and figures underpinning 'Towards the Creation of Legible Octilinear Power Grid Diagrams Using Mixed Integer Linear Programming' is a model or code deposit deposited in Figshare by its authors Paul Cuffe, Kate Clarke. These Python notebooks implement the techniques described in the paper "Towards the Creation of Legible Octilinear Power Grid Diagrams Using Mixed Integer Linear Programming". Kate Clarke wrote this code: Paul Cuffe was in a supervisory role. These materials are also available on GitHub at: https://github.com/kate9871/MetroMap-PowerGrids They are based on work in M. Nollenburg and A. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 12973547 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
